card.name: Dash in page ranges of citations
card.fires_on: The dash or hyphen between the first and last page numbers in a reference, right after the starting page. It also fires on a digit that begins the second half of a range.

modes.label: Page range dash
modes.description: A dash joining start and end pages in a journal or book citation.
modes.example: Scand J Infect Dis. 2004;36:450<<–>>2. - Woolf M. Left

modes.label: Year or number range
modes.description: A dash in a date range of a work, or a digit in a number range.
